name: markdown-frontend-evidence
body: Verified this session (code graph + source read): there is no markdown language id anywhere. `auto_detect_languages` (src/main.rs:488-504) lists java/go/cpp/rust/ts/csharp and no md, and each candidate is gated on membership in the installed-frontend list (`available.iter().any(|l| l == lang)`, l.499); `available_languages()` (src/main.rs:370-401) probes only cppfrontend/gofrontend/rustfrontend/csharpfrontend/java-classes/tsfrontend, so an md candidate added alone could never fire without an md probe there (with the probe form matching the md artifact — bare binary vs Node/Go script); `id_prefix_for` (src/main.rs:510-520) has no md arm; `frontend_cmd` (src/main.rs:406-455) resolves no md frontend (a Node/Go-script artifact needs its own match branch, e.g. the `node <script>` form the ts arm uses); `builtin_code_type` (src/classify.rs:78-185) has no md arm, so a .md path would fall to the `_ => ""src""` default and markdown sources are not scanned at all today. `has_extension` (src/main.rs:457-483) skips only hidden dot entries, `target`, and `node_modules` — it does NOT skip `vendor`/`gen`, so markdown under generated/dependency directories is not excluded by that helper; the plan must state the exclusion set it relies on (or reuse the scan-exclusion rule). build.rs stages each frontend to target/<profile>/frontends with a per-language block (build.rs:9-23, 55, 213-244) and emits APG_LANGUAGES. The markdown frontend is new: it has no code in the scanned graph, so its solution component carries no implemented-by — the plan declares it as planned Implementation nodes (same state as solution.component.js-ts-frontend / rust-manifest-discovery). verified.
